title: Western
story: A sleepy frontier town where everyone sips root beer.
declined: whiskey: no drugs or alcohol, so the pig sips root beer instead
cigar: no drugs or smoking, so the man tips his hat instead

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A tan felt cowboy hat with a wide curved brim, a tall creased crown and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: tan brown felt with a red band

cards.name: Boots
cards.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with pointed toes, tall shafts, stacked heels and pull loops at the tops.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather with red pull loops

cards.name: Sheriff Star

cards.subject: A tall green saguaro cactus with a ribbed trunk and two upward-curving arms, with one small flower on top.
cards.hero_colors: green with a small yellow flower

cards.name: Root Beer
cards.subject: A tall glass mug with a thick handle, filled with brown root beer and a white foam top, standing on a bar counter.
cards.hero_colors: amber brown drink with white foam, clear glass

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A brown leather western saddle with a high front horn, a curved seat, two side flaps and a pair of stirrups hanging from them, resting on a wooden rail.

cards.name: Saloon Doors

cards.name: Campfire

cards.surface_or_setting: bare dirt ground ringed with a few stones
